title: CPP-5: Replace raw CloseHandle/new/delete with WIL/std RAII in hotspots

status.detail: The isolated exact-head local checkout and recorded 13-path candidate patch remain unchanged. Compiler, SDK and native test-framework prerequisites are present and hashed, while isolated NuGet and vcpkg dependencies are not materialized. Repository helpers support MSBuild restore with RestorePackagesConfig enabled, so a separate NuGet CLI is unnecessary. A narrow interop-project restore plan uses the packages.config pins and repository Azure feed, isolates package, install and source-download output, and disables shared vcpkg binary-cache reuse because full binary ABI provenance is not established. Provisioning is prepared but not executed or authorized; no restore, install, build or test result is claimed.
